svg.text: Role-Specific gm/ID Selection Law (Pelgrom + Headroom)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Input Diff-Pair (M1–M2): Choose gm/ID = 14 .. 20 V⁻¹ (Moderate/Weak)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: -> Maximizes gm per µA, crushes input thermal noise & VOS mismatch!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Current Mirrors & Active Loads: Choose gm/ID = 5 .. 8 V⁻¹ (Strong Inv)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: + Long L -> Minimizes current mismatch σ(ΔI/I) & load noise gm_load!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • RF / High-Speed Cascode Shields: Choose gm/ID = 8 .. 12 V⁻¹ -> High fT!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 1 · Compute Required gm from Specs

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gm1 = 2π · GBW · CL,eff (or from thermal noise target 4kTγ/gm1)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 2 · Choose Inversion Operating Point (gm/ID)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pick gm/ID ∈ [5, 22] V⁻¹ -> sets VDS,min ≈ 2 / (gm/ID) automatically!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 3 · Lock Exact Drain Bias Current ID

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ID = gm1 / (gm / ID) (Check power budget & slew rate SR = ISS/CL)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 4 · Select Channel Length L from gm·ro & fT LUT

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Query BSIM4 LUT(L, gm/ID, VDS) so gm·ro ≥ A_target & fT ≥ 10·GBW

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 5 · Compute Width W from Current Density JD = ID/W

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: W = ID / JD(L, gm/ID) -> Fold into even M fingers & run CDF callbacks!
